reports.title: Natera Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Financial Outlook
section: Natera anticipates 2026 total revenue of $3.005 billion to $3.035 billion; gross margin1 to be approximately 64% to 66%; selling, general and administrative costs to be approximately $1.225 billion to $1.300 billion; research and development costs to be $825 million to $925 million; and cash flow to be positive.
